persona: A hospital nurse in her early thirties who works rotating shifts in a mid-sized town. She signed up for her first half marathon on a dare from a colleague, has recently caught the sourdough bug, and is trying to get an old steel bike from a charity shop back on the road so she can cycle to work. She types quickly between tasks and rarely bothers with capital letters.

persona: A retired primary school teacher in his mid sixties who lives alone with a greedy tabby cat on the edge of a market town. He has taken over a neglected allotment, is learning Spanish before a long-promised trip to Andalusia with his brother, and is slowly fixing the small things in his house that he put off for decades. He types carefully and in full sentences, except when he is cross with the tap.
